elements.text:
You had a really long day at school and are feeling tired, so you decide to stay home from the movie night at your friend's house. When you open social media, you see everyone posting about it on Snapchat.

Here are some thoughts that might pop into mind:

texts: I feel like I made the wrong choice, but I couldn't have known how the night would unfold when I decided to stay home.
There will be more chances to see my friends in the future.
Even though I'm not out with my friends, I can still have a nice night in.
